data.notes: As of current primary calendars, February 2027 Dubai music confirmations are sparse; no major festival lineups or arena concerts with specific February dates were found, but Hard Rock Dubai Sports City has recurring live-music/DJ dates posted.

events.title: Saturday Nights with Shanice
events.summary: Hard Rock Dubai Sports City lists Shanice for a Saturday live singer session from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM, billed around live vocals, crowd-favourite tunes, beats, and weekend energy.

events.title: Sunday Afternoons with Shanice & DJ King
events.summary: Hard Rock Dubai Sports City lists this Sunday afternoon live duo with Shanice and DJ King from 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM, combining soulful vocals, upbeat rhythms, and DJ-led crowd favourites.

events.title: XIII International Music & Dance Festival “Dubai Festival Days”
events.summary: World Festival Association lists this international music-and-dance festival in Dubai from 11–17 February 2027. The programme invites folk ensembles, choral groups, orchestras, brass bands, vocal groups, instrumental groups and soloists, with a festival evening included in the published schedule.
